findings.cause: A held inferred position continued to return zero or positive arrival seconds, so waiting and automatic boarding could use lost observations.
findings.fix: No arrival predictions or automatic boarding/reacquisition from holding states.

findings.cause: Duplicate rows within a single packet were all selected before the processed set was updated.
findings.fix: Recheck each observation identity before ingesting it.

findings.cause: The same provider timestamp was assigned a different local timestamp when transport delay changed, refreshing the same sighting.
findings.fix: Retain the provider timestamp as the stable observation identity.

findings.cause: A minutes-old observation many stations upstream could be extrapolated into a near arrival after track confidence expired.
findings.fix: Limit raw sighting projection to the tracker confidence horizon; only direct platform observations confirm an overdue arrival.

findings.cause: Platform requests were not cancelled on background entry and could publish late results or clear a newer request.
findings.fix: Cancel requests on background entry and reject results from superseded requests.

findings.cause: A complete catalog could be replaced with route and stop data that lacked the path feed, invoking guessed parent stop ordering.
findings.fix: Require all essential planning feeds and a nonempty path catalog before replacement.

findings.cause: An HTTP 200 provider error page was cached before its content was validated and could later be reused by 304 responses.
findings.fix: Invalidate rejected compressed or decoded feed bodies before further conditional requests.

upstreamSourceIncident.content: HTML error page titled HTTP Status 500 – Internal Server Error

validation.catalogSource: Exact bundled official metadata, not a substitute for live train data

limits: Public Taipei Metro platform feed contains station, destination and update time, not train identity or GPS. Matched train identities and automatic on-board association are inferred.

Route recommendation is a bounded heuristic search; bus-only trips allow one transfer, mixed trips allow up to three transfers and exclude consecutive bus feeder legs. It does not prove global optimality.
The platform-arrival feed covers Taipei Metro five lines. Circular and Sanying lines have static planning and map data but lack this live feed.
Tunnel depth and structure heights are map models based on OSM tags, not survey measurements.
Physical iPhone frame rate and long-duration battery behavior have not been verified in this audit.
